The device daemon as production runs it on device protocol 3: the files `kinu-cli-linux-x64.tar.gz` installs under
`pc-agent/`, from the build production serves (0.2.0+2620e7c05, its archive's sha256 94c0f6f1…3373 as
`/downloads/kinu-version.json` names it). Each file carries `.txt` so no linter or gate reads it as source.

Tests start it as an installed daemon and push it the current build, so the protocol-3 daemon on an owner's machine
is proved to update to protocol 4. Delete this directory with the update path once no protocol-3 daemon remains.
